price-alerts.title: How to set a crypto price alert (free) | MarketAlert
price-alerts.h1: How do I set a price alert for a crypto coin?
price-alerts.description: Set a free price alert for Binance coins: enter a target price and choose a push notification. Get notified even if the price only touches the target. Works with the app closed.
price-alerts.intro: You don’t need to keep a chart open all day. Pick a coin and a target price; MarketAlert watches the price on its servers and notifies your phone when the target is reached. Even if the price only touches the target for a moment and pulls back, that touch is not missed.
price-alerts.prompt: Notify me once when BTC rises above 70,000 USDT.
price-alerts.caption: In-app example · Quick alert with target price, distance to target and notification choice.
steps: Pick the coin and market
In Quick alert, choose a coin such as BTC, ETH, SOL or BNB, or search. Switch between Spot or Futures and USDT or USDC at the top.
Enter the target price
Type the price, drag to adjust or use the −5%…+5% buttons. The sentence under the card shows what the alert will do and how far the target is.
Choose the notification
Silent or Sound push is available on every plan. Telegram is available on Plus and Pro, signed webhook on Pro.
Set the alert
Tap “Set alert”. Open “Advanced settings” for options such as repeat mode. You can also create the same alert by speaking or typing in AI chat.
details: What if the price touches the target and pulls back?

MarketAlert checks the highest and lowest traded prices. If the price touches 70,000 for a moment and falls back to 69,880, the alert still fires. The notification shows both the touch price and the last price.
Which price is watched?

The traded price on the Binance market you selected. Spot and Futures prices can differ at the same moment, so set the alert on the market you trade. For Bitcoin, the [Bitcoin price alert](coins/bitcoin-price-alert) page explains this gap and short wicks with an example.
Once or every time?
On the free plan an alert notifies once when it reaches the target. On Plus and Pro you can choose a repeating alert and be notified again each time the condition is met.
faq: Are price alerts free?
Yes. The free plan lets you create 3 alerts with price, percentage move and 24h high/low conditions, delivered by push notification.
Do price alerts work when the app is closed?
Yes. Alerts are monitored on MarketAlert servers, so notifications arrive even when the app is closed or in the background.
Can I set several targets for the same coin?
Yes. Create a separate alert for each target. On Plus and Pro you can also combine two price levels with OR in one alert.
Does MarketAlert trade for me?
No. It only sends notifications. It doesn’t connect to your exchange account, place orders or give investment advice.
plans: Free
3 alerts; price, percentage move and 24h high/low. Silent or Sound push. An alert notifies once when it reaches the target.
Plus
20 alerts; repeating alerts and up to 3 conditions per alert. Push and Telegram, all alert sounds.
Pro
100 alerts; up to 5 conditions per alert. Push, Telegram and signed webhook.

percent-change-alerts.title: Crypto percentage change alert: know when a coin moves 3% fast | MarketAlert
percent-change-alerts.h1: How do I get notified when a coin moves 3% or 5% in a short time?
percent-change-alerts.description: Get a free notification when a coin rises or falls by your chosen percentage within a short window such as 5 or 15 minutes. Binance Spot and Futures, USDT and USDC.
percent-change-alerts.intro: Sometimes what matters isn’t the price level but how fast it moves. A percentage change alert tells you when your coin rises or falls by, say, 3% within the minutes you choose. If you want to wait for a fixed level instead, a [crypto price alert](features/price-alerts) is the better fit.
percent-change-alerts.prompt: Tell me if SOL rises 3% within 15 minutes.
percent-change-alerts.caption: Ready-made templates in the app: Pump and Dump catch any coin moving 5% within 5 minutes (all coins, Plus and Pro).
steps: Pick the coin and market
BTC, ETH, SOL or any other coin; Spot or Futures, USDT or USDC. All four markets are open on every plan.
Choose "% move" as the condition type
Enter the window in minutes (e.g. 15) and the threshold in percent (e.g. +3%). For a drop, use a negative value: −3%.
Want both directions?
To catch rises and drops together, combine two conditions [with OR in one alert](features/multi-condition-alerts) (Plus and Pro). On the Free plan you can set two separate alerts.
Choose the notification
Silent or Sound push is on every plan. Telegram comes with Plus and Pro.
details: What is the percentage measured against?

The price change within the window you choose. A 15-minute alert looks at how much the price moved over the last 15 minutes and fires when the move reaches your threshold. So it catches sharp moves, not a slow climb spread over days.
Which window and threshold should I use?

For large coins even 2–3% in 15 minutes is a notable move; small coins often move 5–10% in the same time. If it fires too often, raise the threshold or shorten the window. Bitcoin-specific examples are on the [Bitcoin price alert](coins/bitcoin-price-alert) page.
Catching pumps and dumps across all coins

If you want any coin moving 5% within 5 minutes rather than one coin, use the Pump and Dump templates. Scanning all coins covers the top 100 on Plus and every coin on Pro; we explain how it works on the [all-coins alerts](features/all-coins-alerts) page. To confirm the move with volume, combine it with a [volume spike alert](features/volume-spike-alerts).
faq: Is the percentage change alert free?
Yes. The Free plan gives you 3 alerts and includes the % move condition with push notifications. The alert notifies once when the condition is met.
How is it different from a price alert?

A price alert waits for a fixed level (e.g. 85,000). A percentage change alert ignores the level and looks at how far the price moved within a window, so it catches sudden rises and drops wherever the price is.
Does it fire again on every sharp move?
On the Free plan the alert fires once. On Plus and Pro you can choose a repeating alert and get notified again whenever the condition is met again.
Does it work when the app is closed?
Yes. Alerts are watched on MarketAlert’s servers, so notifications arrive even when the app is closed or in the background.
plans: Free
3 alerts; price, percentage move and 24h high/low. Silent or Sound push. An alert notifies once when its condition is met.
Plus
20 alerts; repeating alerts, up to 3 conditions per alert and 2 all-coins alerts on the top 100. Push and Telegram.
Pro
100 alerts; up to 5 conditions per alert and 10 all-coins alerts across every coin. Push, Telegram and signed webhook.

all-coins-alerts.title: One alert for every coin: scan the top 100 or all coins on Binance | MarketAlert
all-coins-alerts.h1: How do I track every coin with a single alert?
all-coins-alerts.description: Set one alert and let MarketAlert scan the top 50, 100, 200 or all coins on Binance for your condition. Every matching coin is reported separately. Plus and Pro.
all-coins-alerts.intro: Instead of opening hundreds of charts one by one, write your condition once. An all-coins alert keeps watching the coins in the Binance market you choose and reports every coin that meets the condition separately. If you only want to follow one coin, a [crypto price alert](features/price-alerts) or a [percentage change alert](features/percent-change-alerts) is enough.
all-coins-alerts.prompt: Tell me if any top-100 coin rises 5% within 5 minutes and its volume is up too.
all-coins-alerts.caption: The voice assistant turned the same sentence into one alert: scope top 100 coins, two conditions together: a 5% rise within 5 minutes and volume above 3× SMA(20).
steps: Pick the market
Binance Spot or Futures, USDT or USDC. Each market is scanned separately; an alert set on Spot USDT does not look at Futures coins.
Set the scope to "All coins"
Instead of one coin, choose the top 50, top 100, top 200 or all coins. Plus goes up to the top 100, Pro up to every coin.
Build the condition
Price, percentage move, 24h high/low, RSI, MACD, volume or moving averages. You can [combine conditions with AND / OR](features/multi-condition-alerts), and describe them by voice or text too.
Choose the notification pace

Pick it on the "All-coins notifications" page in Settings. Instant sends every match right away. Balanced sends the first one right away with sound and bundles the rest into short silent groups. Digest delivers matches in 15-minute summaries. This setting is for push; Telegram comes with Plus and Pro, webhook with Pro.
ready: You get a notification when the condition is met.
details: The condition is checked for each coin on its own

An all-coins alert checks your condition against each coin’s own data. If you ask for "up 5% AND volume spike", both must happen on the same coin; one coin’s rise is never paired with another coin’s volume. Every matching coin is saved separately on the Notifications screen.
How is the "top 100" decided?

Top N options follow the 24-hour trading volume ranking, and stablecoins are left out of the scan. The scope is the eligible coins in the Binance market you choose, not every asset on every exchange. As the ranking changes, coins move in and out of the list.
Which conditions work well for scanning?

A [percentage move](features/percent-change-alerts) catches sudden moves across the market, [RSI](features/rsi-alerts) finds oversold coins, and a [volume spike](features/volume-spike-alerts) shows unusual interest. The looser the condition, the more coins match; if you get too many notifications, tighten the threshold, narrow the scope or switch to Digest.
faq: Is the all-coins alert free?
No. The Free plan has single-coin alerts. Plus gives you 2 all-coins alerts up to the top 100, and Pro gives you 10 across every coin.
How many coins does one alert watch?
As many as your scope: the top 50, 100, 200 or every eligible coin in the market. All of it is managed from a single alert.
What if I get too many notifications?
Switch the pace to Balanced or Digest; Digest bundles 15 minutes of matches into one notification. A tighter threshold or a second condition also cuts the number of matches.
Does it work when the app is closed?
Yes. The scan runs on MarketAlert’s servers, so notifications arrive even when the app is closed or in the background.
Is a matching coin a buy or sell signal?
No. MarketAlert only reports the condition you defined; it never tells you which coin to buy or sell.
plans: Free
3 alerts; price, percentage move and 24h high/low for a single coin. All-coins alerts are not included.
Plus
20 alerts; 2 all-coins alerts up to the top 100, every condition type and up to 3 conditions per alert. Push and Telegram.
Pro
100 alerts; 10 all-coins alerts across every coin and up to 5 conditions per alert. Push, Telegram and signed webhook.

volume-spike-alerts.title: How to set Binance volume spike alerts | MarketAlert
volume-spike-alerts.h1: How do I get alerts when Binance coin volume spikes?
volume-spike-alerts.description: Set Binance volume spike alerts with your timeframe, volume average and multiplier. Create by voice or AI chat and receive Telegram notifications.
volume-spike-alerts.intro: Set your own threshold instead of refreshing volume rankings. MarketAlert scans coins on your selected Binance market and notifies you when candle volume exceeds your chosen multiple of its volume average.
volume-spike-alerts.prompt: Scan the top 100 coins by volume on Binance Spot USDT. Notify me once on Telegram when 15-minute candle volume exceeds 3 times its 20-period volume average.
volume-spike-alerts.caption: In-app example · Your request, volume condition and notification channel together.
steps: Specify the market and scope
Choose Spot or Futures, USDT or USDC, and a single coin or the all-coins scope.
Define the volume condition
This example uses 15m candles, a 20-period SMA and a 3× multiplier. Adjust these to your needs.
Speak or approve a chat draft
Say the command or type it in AI chat. In text chat, review and approve the generated draft.
Check delivery and repeat settings
Link Telegram from the app. Check the scope, notification channel and once/repeating preference.
details: What does 3× volume mean?
The condition compares candle volume with the selected SMA volume average. If the average is 100 units, volume above 300 meets this example’s threshold. It does not mean a 3% price increase.
More volume does not mean a higher price
Volume can increase while price falls. Add another condition, such as price above an EMA. With AND, both conditions must hold for the same coin.
Which coins are scanned?
Eligible USDT/USDC coins on the selected Binance market are scanned, excluding stablecoins. Top 50/100/200 or all-coins availability depends on the plan.
faq: Are volume alerts evaluated at candle close?
Yes. The volume indicator uses closed candles on your selected timeframe. This is not an intrabar volume spike notification.
Can one alert cover every coin?
All-coins scope applies one definition across eligible coins. Plus supports up to the top 100; Pro supports all eligible coins.
Is this a trading signal?
It reports that your own volume condition was met. It does not place orders or guarantee price direction or profit.

multi-condition-alerts.title: RSI and EMA alerts together, without coding | MarketAlert
multi-condition-alerts.h1: How do I get an alert when RSI and EMA conditions both match?
multi-condition-alerts.description: Combine RSI and price/EMA conditions in one crypto alert. Set it by voice without code or forms, scan Binance coins and receive Telegram notifications.
multi-condition-alerts.intro: You do not have to monitor a separate RSI alert and price alert. Combine your conditions in one alert with AND or OR, then create it by speaking or typing in AI chat.
multi-condition-alerts.prompt: Scan the top 100 coins by volume on Binance Spot USDT. Notify me once on Telegram when hourly RSI is below 30 and price is above EMA20.
multi-condition-alerts.caption: In-app example · User message, both conditions and delivery channel together.
steps: Describe both conditions in one sentence
Specify the market, coin scope, timeframe, RSI threshold and EMA period.
Choose how conditions combine
Use AND when both are required, or OR when either condition is enough.
Speak or approve the draft
Tell the voice assistant or type in AI chat. In text chat, review the draft and create the alert.
Check the result and Telegram channel
Verify RSI(14) < 30, price > EMA(20), 1h, top 100 coins and Telegram delivery.
details: AND versus OR
With AND, RSI at 28 is not enough if price is below EMA20. RSI at 28 with price above EMA20 satisfies the combination. OR needs only one condition.
How do conditions combine across coins?
Conditions are evaluated together for each coin. BTC’s RSI is not combined with ETH’s EMA condition. One coin must satisfy both for the AND combination to match.
Above an EMA is not an EMA crossover
This example requires price above EMA20, without waiting for a new crossing. RSI and EMA use closed candles. This does not define a sequence of events.
faq: Do I need code or Pine Script?
No. Combine supported conditions in MarketAlert by voice, AI text chat or the alert form.
Can I add more than two conditions?
Plus supports up to 3 conditions per alert and Pro up to 5. Use RSI, volume, price/moving-average and other supported condition types.
Why might I receive no Telegram notification?
Check that Telegram is linked and the alert is active. AND requires every condition on the same coin; repeat preferences and plan notification limits also apply.

voice-crypto-alerts.title: Set crypto alerts by voice: RSI, volume and price with a voice assistant | MarketAlert
voice-crypto-alerts.h1: How do you set a crypto alert by voice?
voice-crypto-alerts.description: Say your alert and the MarketAlert voice assistant sets it up: a price on one coin or RSI and volume on the top 100. Change, list or delete alerts by voice.
voice-crypto-alerts.intro: Tap the microphone and say your alert the way you would tell a person. The voice assistant turns your sentence into conditions; if the request is clear it creates the alert right away, and if something is missing it asks. The same way you can change, list and delete your alerts. Prefer a form? See the [crypto price alert](features/price-alerts) guide.
voice-crypto-alerts.prompt: Tell me when RSI is under 30 and volume is 2 times on the top 100 coins
voice-crypto-alerts.exampleTitle: Every part of your sentence becomes a setting
voice-crypto-alerts.caption: The voice assistant result screen: the spoken sentence, the created alert, its scope and two conditions.
steps: Tap the microphone

Open the voice assistant with the microphone on the My alerts screen. In Automatic mode listening ends when you stop talking, and the assistant listens again after each reply. In Hold to talk mode it listens while you press the button.
Say what you want

Say the coin or the scope (for example the top 100 coins), the condition and, if you like, the candle timeframe and the notification channel. Your speech is turned into text on your device; only the text is sent.
The assistant understands
It turns coin names, indicators and numbers into alert conditions. If it is not clear which coin or which alert you mean, it asks a short question and you answer by voice again.
The alert is created
If the request is clear, the alert is created at once and its card appears on screen. Use "Open alert" to see the details, or speak again to change a setting.
details: Which alerts can the voice assistant create?

Price, percent move, 24-hour high/low, RSI, MACD, volume spike and moving average conditions. It sets the alert for one coin or for the top 50, 100, 200 or all coins, and can [combine conditions with AND / OR](features/multi-condition-alerts). Which conditions you can use depends on your plan.
How is your speech handled?

Your speech is turned into text on your device, in the app language; no audio recording is sent. The assistant reads that text and creates the alert on MarketAlert's servers. The alert keeps working while the app is closed.
Voice assistant or text AI chat?

With the voice assistant a clear request is applied directly and a result card is shown. In the text AI chat the assistant first shows a draft and the alert is created when you approve it. Both create the same alerts, so use whichever feels easier.
faq: Is the voice assistant free?
Yes, it is on every plan; you need to sign in with an account, it cannot be used as a guest. Each sentence uses 1 AI message. On Free the allowance renews daily, on Plus and Pro weekly.
Which language should I speak?
Speak in the language you use the app in. Your speech is turned into text in that language on your device.
Can I delete an alert by voice?
Yes. Just say "Delete my ETH alert". If you have more than one ETH alert, or it is not clear which alert you mean, the assistant asks first.
What if the assistant gets it wrong?
The result card shows every setting of the created alert. You can change a wrong setting by saying so, or delete the alert. If it corrected a word it heard, it shows that in the speech bubble.
Does the voice assistant trade?
No. It only creates and manages alerts; it never connects to an exchange account, never places orders and gives no investment advice.
plans: Free
3 alerts; set price, percent move and 24h high/low alerts for a single coin by voice. Change, list and delete alerts by voice. Daily AI allowance.
Plus
20 alerts; every condition type, up to 3 conditions per alert and 2 all-coins alerts up to the top 100. Push and Telegram. Weekly AI allowance.
Pro
100 alerts; up to 5 conditions per alert and 10 all-coins alerts across every coin. Push, Telegram and signed webhook. Larger weekly AI allowance.

telegram-crypto-alerts.title: Get Binance price alerts on Telegram: setup | MarketAlert
telegram-crypto-alerts.h1: How do I get Binance price alerts on Telegram?
telegram-crypto-alerts.description: Connect MarketAlert to Telegram once and pick Telegram on your alert: price, RSI, volume and all-coins alerts arrive in your chat. No chat ID or API key needed.
telegram-crypto-alerts.intro: You connect Telegram to the app once, then pick it as the notification channel when you set an alert. When the alert fires, the message comes from the MarketAlert bot to your own Telegram chat, and a push notification can arrive at the same time if you want. You never enter a chat ID, a bot token or a Binance API key. The alerts you can send to Telegram are explained on the [crypto price alerts](features/price-alerts) and [all-coins alerts](features/all-coins-alerts) pages.

steps: Connect Telegram
In the app, go to Settings › Telegram and tap “Connect Telegram”. The app opens Telegram and takes you to the MarketAlert bot chat. If Telegram isn't installed, install it first.
Press START in Telegram
The “MarketAlert: Crypto Alerts” bot chat opens. Press the START button at the bottom.
/start is sent

Pressing START sends /start to the chat, and your account is matched with it. You don't need to type anything else. The link is valid for a short time; if it expires, tap “Create new link” in the app.
Go back to the app
The status changes to “Telegram is connected” on its own. Only the last four digits of the connected chat are shown.
Pick Telegram on an alert

When you set an alert, tick Telegram under Notification › Channel. You can keep push on too; more than one channel can be selected. You can also just tell the [voice assistant](features/voice-crypto-alerts) “notify me on Telegram”.
details: Which plans include Telegram?

Telegram notifications are part of Plus and Pro, and both come with a 7-day free trial. On the Free plan notifications arrive as push. If you move to Free, alerts set to Telegram send push notifications instead.
What does a Telegram message show?

The first line says what happened, for example “BTC rose above 105,000”. The second line shows the name you gave the alert. Below are the current value, the target, the candle interval and the market. Single-coin messages have a button that opens the Binance chart.
How do all-coins alerts arrive on Telegram?

The “All-coins signal mode” in Settings › Telegram decides. Default sends single messages or a summary as the system sees fit, Instant sends each signal right away as its own message, and Summary collects signals and sends them in one message at set intervals. Single-coin alerts always arrive right away. Scanning all coins covers the top 100 on Plus and every coin on Pro; details are on the [all-coins alerts](features/all-coins-alerts) page.
Is it safe?

MarketAlert never connects to your exchange account, never asks for an API key and never trades. The bot only sends notifications; it never asks for passwords, API keys or payments. Messages go only to your private chat with the bot.
faq: Do I need a chat ID or a bot token for Telegram alerts?
No. The “Connect Telegram” button in the app opens the bot; pressing START is all it takes.
Are Telegram notifications free?
Telegram is part of Plus and Pro, and both have a 7-day free trial. On the Free plan notifications arrive as push.
Can I get both push and Telegram?
Yes. Select both under Notification › Channel on the alert; the same signal reaches both.
Can I send alerts to a Telegram group or channel?
No. Notifications go only to your own private chat with the MarketAlert bot.
How do I disconnect Telegram?

Tap “Remove Telegram connection” at the bottom of Settings › Telegram. Once removed, alerts using the Telegram channel can't send Telegram messages; you can reconnect anytime. To switch to another account, use “Connect another account”.
I pressed START but it didn't connect. What now?
The app checks the status by itself, so give it a moment. If the link has expired, tap “Create new link” and press START again in the chat that opens.

macd-crossover-alerts.title: How to set a MACD signal crossover alert | MarketAlert
macd-crossover-alerts.h1: How do I get an alert when MACD crosses its signal line?
macd-crossover-alerts.description: Get a push and Telegram notification when the MACD line crosses its signal line up or down, checked when the candle closes. Default 12·26·9, timeframes from 1 minute to 1 day.
macd-crossover-alerts.intro: You pick the coin, the direction of the cross and the timeframe. When a candle on that timeframe closes and the MACD line has crossed its signal line, MarketAlert sends a push to your phone, and the message can also go to [Telegram](features/telegram-crypto-alerts). To use MACD together with other conditions such as RSI, see [multi-condition alerts](features/multi-condition-alerts).
macd-crossover-alerts.prompt: Tell me when BNB's MACD crosses below its signal on the daily chart
macd-crossover-alerts.exampleTitle: MACD alerts in your alert list
macd-crossover-alerts.caption: The alert list in the app: BNB daily cross below; cross above on BTC 4-hour, ETH hourly and the top 100 coins hourly.
steps: Tap Create an alert
On the Alerts screen tap Create an alert and choose the coin, for example BNB.
Choose MACD as the condition type
In the condition type window tap MACD in the Indicator group. MACD is available on Plus and Pro.
Choose the direction
Under “When should we notify you?” choose Crosses above or Crosses below. Crosses above means MACD moves from below the signal line to above it; crosses below is the opposite.
Choose the timeframe
1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h or 1d. The cross is checked when a candle of that size closes. Fast, slow and signal periods start at 12, 26 and 9; you can change them.
Save and pick the channel
Tap Save condition, then choose the notification channel: push, Telegram on Plus and Pro, signed webhook on Pro. Save the alert.
details: What are the MACD and signal lines?

The MACD line is the difference between two exponential moving averages of 12 and 26 candles. The signal line is the 9-candle average of that difference and follows MACD a little behind. When MACD moves from below the signal line to above it, that is a cross above; from above to below, a cross below.
What does the notification say?

The push title reads like “BNB MACD crossed below signal”; below it are the periods, the timeframe and the MACD and signal values. The Telegram message also shows the price and the market, with a button that opens the Binance chart.
Can I set it on all coins?

Yes. If you choose all coins instead of one coin, the same cross is watched on every coin in the group you pick, and the coins that cross are reported to you. It runs up to the top 100 on Plus and on every coin on Pro. Details are on the [all-coins alerts](features/all-coins-alerts) page.
Is it a buy or sell signal?
No. MarketAlert only tells you when the cross you chose happens. It does not trade, does not connect to an exchange account and does not give investment advice.
faq: Is the MACD alert free?
MACD alerts are on Plus and Pro, both with a 7-day free trial. On Free you can set price, percent move and 24-hour high/low alerts.
Can I use values other than 12, 26, 9?
Yes. The fast and slow periods can be between 2 and 200, and the slow period must be larger than the fast one. The signal period is between 1 and 200.
Which timeframes are there?
1 minute, 5 minutes, 15 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours and 1 day. The cross is checked when a candle of the size you chose closes.
Why doesn't a cross on an open candle count?
Before a candle closes the lines can cross and cross back. That is why indicator alerts use closed candles; on a daily alert the cross is known when the daily candle closes at 00:00 UTC.
Can I combine MACD with RSI?
Yes. You can add conditions to one alert with AND / OR: up to 3 on Plus and 5 on Pro. See [multi-condition alerts](features/multi-condition-alerts) for examples.
Is there an alert for the histogram or the zero line?
No. The MACD alert only looks at the MACD line crossing its signal line.

24h-high-low-alerts.title: How to set a 24-hour high and low alert. Free | MarketAlert
24h-high-low-alerts.h1: How do I get an alert when a coin breaks its 24-hour high?
24h-high-low-alerts.description: Get a push and Telegram notification when a Binance coin breaks its highest or lowest price of the last 24 hours. On the Free plan; set it up by typing or talking to the AI.
24h-high-low-alerts.intro: Not “today”, but the last 24 hours counted back from every moment. You pick the coin and the move: new high, new low or either. At the close of the minute in which the price passes the window’s high or drops below its low, MarketAlert sends a push to your phone, and the message can also go to [Telegram](features/telegram-crypto-alerts). You can set the same alert on [all coins](features/all-coins-alerts) too.
24h-high-low-alerts.prompt: Tell me if any top 100 coin breaks its 24-hour high, once an hour is enough.
24h-high-low-alerts.caption: The orange dot is the price at that moment. The high and low are measured over the 24 hours before the dot.
steps: Type or say it to the AI

On the AI screen, write your request in your own words or tap the microphone and say it, for example “Tell me if BTC breaks its 24-hour high”. If something is missing, the AI asks, then sets the alert.
Or tap the template
The “24-hour high breakout” template under the AI screen brings a ready draft. Templates don’t use your AI allowance; change the coin and set the alert.
To use the form, pick the condition type
On Create an alert, choose the coin, then tap “24h high/low” in the condition type window.
Choose the move and save
Choose “New high”, “New low” or “Either” and tap Save condition. Pick the notification channel and save the alert.
details: How is the 24-hour high measured?

At the close of every minute, MarketAlert takes the highest and lowest price of the 24 hours before that minute (1,440 one-minute candles). If the minute’s high goes above that high, it is a new high; if its low goes below the low, it is a new low. Touching isn’t enough; it has to pass. Because the window moves every minute, an old high drops out after 24 hours and the bar comes down.
What does the notification say?
The push title reads like “SOL broke its 24h high”, with the price and the 24h high below it. The Telegram message shows the new high or low, the market and a button that opens the Binance chart.
How does it work on all coins?

If you choose all coins instead of one coin, each coin is watched against its own 24 hours and the ones that break are reported to you. It runs on the top 100 on Plus and on every coin on Pro. On all coins the alert repeats, waiting the time you choose between two notifications for the same coin.
Is it a buy or sell signal?
No. MarketAlert only tells you when the break you chose happens. It does not trade, does not connect to an exchange account and does not give investment advice.
faq: Is the 24-hour high/low alert free?
Yes. You can set it for a single coin on the Free plan. Telegram and all coins are on Plus and Pro, both with a 7-day free trial.
How is it different from today’s high?
A calendar day resets at midnight. This alert always looks at the last 24 hours back from now; the window moves minute by minute.
Does it notify once or on every break?

For one coin you can set it to fire once or to repeat. When it repeats, you choose how long to wait between two notifications, at least 10 minutes. On all coins it always repeats. Repeating alerts are on Plus and Pro.
If the price touches the high and turns back, do I get a notification?
No. For a new high the minute’s high must be greater than the previous 24-hour high; being equal isn’t enough.
Does it work on a newly listed coin?
It starts once the coin has 24 hours of data. Until then there isn’t a full 24 hours to compare with.
How do I set it up with the AI?

Type it on the AI screen or say it to the [voice assistant](features/voice-crypto-alerts). On all coins, if you didn’t say how long to wait, the AI asks: “How long should I wait between two notifications of this repeating 24-hour alert? For example 1 hour.”
